metadata.title: ओडिशा में आदिवासी ज़मीन कानून में बदलाव ? Threat to tribal land rights in Odisha | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: A cabinet decision allowing tribals to transfer their land to non-tribals by way of amending the Orissa Scheduled Areas Transfer of Immovable Property (by Scheduled Tribes) Regulation 1956 triggered a massive controversy, forcing the Naveen Patnaik government to put the two-day-old decision on hold on November 16. The cabinet decision evoked strong resistance from tribal communities as well as activists working on tribal rights. They said the amendment would open the floodgates as far as the transfer of tribal land is concerned.
